Your first screen is ready. Open it here: **http://maker:4001**

**This is flow 1 — quickly saving a link.** Please try this one action:

> In the box at the top, paste a link — for example `https://developer.mozilla.org` — and press **Save**.

Watch what happens: the app briefly looks up the page, then the bookmark appears in your list with a **title filled in automatically**, and the box clears so you're ready to save the next one.

A couple of things I decided for you here that I'd like you to check as you try it:

- I set the **save box at the very top**, always visible, so saving stays quick — does that placement feel right, or would you expect to save some other way?
- For each saved link I'm showing the **title, the address, and a short description** (when the page has one). Is that the right set of details to see at a glance, or is something missing or unnecessary?

Give it a go and tell me how it feels — especially whether the auto-filled title behaves the way you'd expect.
